question: Which Article of the Constitution of India mentions that the state shall make effective provision for securing public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness and disablement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 41**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 41** of the Indian Constitution is part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**, enshrined in Part IV of the Constitution.
 
• This article directs the state to make **effective provisions** for securing the **right to work, education, and public assistance** in cases of **unemployment, old age, sickness, and disablement.**
 
• It emphasizes the state's responsibility to promote **welfare policies** within the limits of its **economic capacity and development.**
 
• The Directive Principles, including Article 41, are **non-justiciable**, meaning they cannot be enforced in a court of law, but they serve as **guidelines** for the state to establish a just and equitable society.
 
• Article 41 reflects the Constitution's vision of a **welfare state**, aiming to safeguard the **social and economic rights** of all citizens.
 
• This provision is particularly significant in addressing **social security** concerns for vulnerable and marginalized sections of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 45**__

 __
 
• **Article 45** originally mandated the state to provide **free and compulsory education** for all children up to the age of 14 years within a period of 10 years from the commencement of the Constitution.
 
• However, this was later modified to focus on providing **early childhood care and education** for children below 6 years of age, through the **86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002.**
 
 
 
• **Article 47**__
 __
 
• **Article 47** directs the state to raise the level of **nutrition and the standard of living** of its people and improve **public health.**
 
• It also emphasizes the prohibition of the consumption of **intoxicating drinks and drugs**, except for medicinal purposes.
 
 
 
• **Article 39**__
 
 
• **Article 39** lays down certain principles of **policy** to be followed by the state, such as securing an adequate means of livelihood for all citizens and ensuring that the operation of the economic system does not result in the concentration of wealth and means of production.
 
• It also includes provisions for the protection of the **health and strength** of workers and children.
